description: Add Photoshop-style layer styles (Layer > Layer Styles: Drop Shadow, Inner Shadow, Outer Glow, Inner Glow, Bevel and Emboss, Satin, Color Overlay, Gradient Overlay, Stroke), Remove All, Convert to Editable Styles, and set Blending Options (Global Light, Fill Opacity, channels, Blend Interior Styles as Group, Use Blend Ranges from Source). The style commands select the layers and make their composition active; set each style's own values with set_property

blending.description: Blending Options (present once a layer has a style)

blendInteriorStylesAsGroup.description: Interior styles use the layer blending mode

blue.description: Blue channel takes part in blending

fillOpacity.description: Percent: fades the contents but not the styles

green.description: Green channel takes part in blending

red.description: Red channel takes part in blending

useBlendRangesFromSource.description: Use the blend ranges stored in the Photoshop source

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

convertToEditable.description: Turn styles merged from a Photoshop layer into editable styles (Convert to Editable Styles)

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

removeAll.description: First remove every layer style (Remove All)

name: set_layer_styles
title: Set Layer Styles
